name: creative-coding
title: Creative coding
description: One-file HTML/JS visuals with sound - canvas or Three.js scenes, particles, simulations, generative art, small animated worlds with WebAudio ambience and effects; plan in three lines, write one file, render, fix the top three findings.

overlaps.canvas-2d: the general canvas rules (dpr, loop, layers) stay there; this package adds the plan, the seed and key rules, the sound rule and the defaults
overlaps.web-audio: the general WebAudio rules stay there; this package's reference holds the creative patterns (bed, wind, event sounds, sequencer, voices)
overlaps.threejs-scene: the general Three.js rules stay there and are the three_d class's core; references/threejs-skeleton.md is the one-file creative variant

calibration.note: median fps of the exemplar at 640x360 on the box's software WebGL, minus 20 %, written here once by the calibration run
